correctness.rationale: The GP(10,2) ordinary edge-matching complex contains 111375 nonempty faces with all face-size counts (1,30,375,2540,10155,24474,34805,27300,10260,1400,36). Fresh execution of inspected verify_morse.py at exact frozen SHA reproduced all 10 unique-path cancellations, 55626 acyclic matching pairs, critical cells one 0-cell, five 5-cells, 117 6-cells, 666330 Hasse incidences and a signed zero 5x117 integral boundary. The 5-skeleton is wedge5 S5, Hurewicz pi5≅H5 means all six-cell attaching maps null. The F2 code was read, not independently rerun. This establishes integral homotopy rather than just mod-2 Betti numbers.
